```{r load data and color code, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
library(Seurat)

library(ggplot2)

library(patchwork)

library(scRepertoire)
library(scCustomize)
library(purrr)

T8 <- readRDS("~/R/T8.rds")
T8@meta.data$cloneType_2 -> T8@meta.data$cloneSize

T8tum <- subset(T8, subset = tissue == "tumor")
T8LN <- subset(T8, subset = tissue == "LN")



col_T8 = c(
  "Tcentral mem(1)" =  "#edba40",
  "Tearly act(1)" = "#e28c33",
  "Teff(1)"  = "#e0652b",
  "Tcentral mem(2)" = "#AED140",
  "Tearly act(2)" =  "#2DA049",

  "Texh(1)"= "#03a9f4" ,
  "Texh(2)" = "#2196f3",
  "Texh(3)" = "#3f51b5",
  "Texh(4)" = "#673ab7" ,
  "Tprolif" = "#9c27b0",

)
```

```{r reorder CD8.Cell.Types}
my_seurat_object <- T8
#my_seurat_object@active.ident <- factor(my_seurat_object@active.ident, levels = c("Cluster1", "Cluster2", "Cluster3"))

# Get existing cluster identities
current_clusters <- my_seurat_object$CD8.Cell.Types
levels(current_clusters)
# Define the new order (e.g., from a specific plot or cell type identification)
desired_order <- c("Tcentral mem(1)","Tearly act(1)","Teff(1)",
                   "Tcentral mem(2)","Tearly act(2)","Teff(2)",
                   "Tlate act","Teff(3)",
                   "Tcytotoxic",
                   "Texh(1)", "Texh(2)", "Texh(3)", "Texh(4)", "Tprolif", "Tmisc", "Tc17/MAIT")

# Re-level the factor
my_seurat_object$CD8.Cell.Types <- factor(current_clusters, levels = desired_order)

T8 <- my_seurat_object
rm(my_seurat_object)

```

## Figure 3B - heatmap selected genes
```{r heatmap}
allgenes <- c( # naive like markers
                "CCR7","NOSIP","LEF1","SELL","TCF7","IL7R",
              
              # cytokines and effector molecules
              "GZMB", "FASL", 
                "IL2","CXCR3","GZMK","TNFAIP3","TNF", "IFNG",
               "KLRC1","KLRC2","KLRD1", "KLRK1",
                "XCL1", "XCL2",  "CCL5",
              "GZMH", "GNLY", "PRF1", "NKG7",
               "CX3CR1", 
             
               
               # costim
              "CD226","ICOS", "CD40LG", "TNFRSF4","TNFRSF18","TNFRSF9","TNFSF9",
           "LAYN","CD27", "CD28",


              ## inhib checkponts
              "BTLA","CD274","PDCD1LG2", "CTLA4",
               "TIGIT", "PDCD1", "HAVCR2","LAG3",
              # Trm markers
              "ZNF683", "ITGAE", "ENTPD1",
              # transcription factors
              "EOMES","ZEB2","TBX21","ID2", "HOPX", "TOX2", "TOX",
              # cycling / proliferating
              "MKI67", "STMN1",
              "KLRB1",  "IL23R", "RORC")


# Calculate average expression per cluster
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(object = T8, group.by = "CD8.Cell.Types") # should I use AggregateExpression ?
avg_expr <- AggregateExpression(object = T8, group.by = "CD8.Cell.Types") # should I use AverageExpression?


# Extract the expression matrix
avg_expr_matrix <- avg_expr$RNA

# subset_matrix contains the expression values for allgenes per cluster
subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[rownames(avg_expr_matrix) %in% allgenes, ]

# order rows
row_names <- rownames(avg_expr_matrix)

# Determine order based on 'allgenes'
ordered_indices <- order(match(row_names, allgenes))

# Reassign ordered row names
subset_matrix <- avg_expr_matrix[ordered_indices, ]
subset_matrix <- subset_matrix[rownames(subset_matrix) %in% allgenes, ]


### scale with z-score
cal_z_score <- function(x){
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

# heatmap
data_subset_norm <- t(apply(subset_matrix, 1, cal_z_score))

pheatmap(data_subset_norm,
              #color = hcl.colors(50, "RdGy", rev = T),
              #order_color = NA,
              #scale = "row",
              cutree_rows = F,
              cellwidth = 12,
              #cellheight = 15,
              cluster_rows = F,
              cluster_cols = F)
```

## Fig 3D1 - Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type
```{r cell counts per patient and tissue}

md <- T8@meta.data

# create a table with cell counts per cluster per patient and tissue
cell_count <- unique(md$patient_true) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(patient_true == p) %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue, CD8.Cell.Types) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })


# make a stacked bar chart of the frequency per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = patient_true, y = percentage, fill = CD8.Cell.Types)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_T8) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
   # title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "CD8 cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

## FIG 3F1 - shannon diversity index t.test
```{r shannon diversity}
## shannon diversity per tissue per patient

T8LN_dim <- subset(T8LN, subset =! is.na(T8LN@meta.data$overlap_2))
T8tum_dim <- subset(T8tum, subset =! is.na(T8tum@meta.data$overlap_2))

t1 <- clonalDiversity(T8LN_dim, 
                      cloneCall = "CTgene", 
                      group.by = "patient_true",
                      metric = "shannon",
                      palette = "viridis",
                      exportTable = T)

t2 <- clonalDiversity(T8tum_dim, 
                      cloneCall = "CTgene", 
                      group.by = "patient_true",
                      metric = "shannon",
                      exportTable = T)

shannon <- as.data.frame(cbind(c(t1$patient_true), c(t1$shannon), c(t2$shannon)))
colnames(shannon) <- c("patient", "LN", "tumor")
shannon$LN <- as.numeric(shannon$LN)
shannon$tumor <- as.numeric(shannon$tumor)
res <- t.test(c(shannon$LN), c(shannon$tumor), paired = T)
res

write.csv(shannon, 'CD8.Fig3.shannon.tissue.csv')


```

## FIG 3F2 - shannon diversity index
```{r shannon diversity}
## zie graphpad
df_long <- pivot_longer(shannon, cols = c(LN, tumor), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = type, y = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("LN", "tumor")), method = "t.test", label = "p.signif") + 
  labs(
    title = "shannon diversity index",
    y = "index",
    x = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Rotate x-axis labels
    legend.position = "none"                             # Remove legend
  ) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c(Tissue.Col)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 6))
```


## Fig 3G - clonotype tissue sharing per patient
```{r}
col_overlap <- c("Y" = "#EC5E27", "N" = "#403D39", "NA" = "grey")

order <- c("Y", "N", "NA")

md <- T8@meta.data
# create a table with OVERLAP per cluster per patient and tissue
cell_count <- unique(md$patient_true) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(patient_true == p) %>%
      group_by(patient_true, overlap_2) %>% ## add tissue if split by tissue
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(patient_true) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })

# make a stacked bar chart of the proportion per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = patient_true, y = percentage, fill = factor(overlap_2, order))) + ## factor + order to adjust order
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_overlap) +
 # facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
    # title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "clonotype sharing"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Fig S3E - stacked bar plots relative shared/locexp/NA cells in CD4 per patient
``` {r}
T4 <- readRDS("~/R/T4.harmony.rds")

col_overlap <- c("Y" = "#EC5E27", "N" = "#403D39", "NA" = "grey")

order <- c("Y", "N", "NA")

md <- T8@meta.data
# create a table with OVERLAP per cluster per patient and tissue
cell_count <- unique(md$patient_true) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(patient_true == p) %>%
      group_by(patient_true, overlap_2) %>% ## add tissue if split by tissue
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(patient_true) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })

# make a stacked bar chart of the proportion per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = patient_true, y = percentage, fill = factor(overlap_2, order))) + ## factor + order to adjust order
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_overlap) +
 # facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
    # title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "clonotype sharing"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
